import os,glob,re
def load():

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

G=load(); print(sorted(G))

from collections import Counter
def transform(g):
    bg=g[0][0]
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r if v!=bg)
    inner=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    def colored(v): return v!=bg and v!=inner
    rows=[r for r in range(H) if any(colored(v) for v in g[r])]
    cols=[c for c in range(W) if any(colored(g[r][c]) for r in range(H))]
    R=len(rows)-1; C=len(cols)-1
    out=[[inner]*C for _ in range(R)]
    for i in range(R):
        r1,r2=rows[i],rows[i+1]
        for j in range(C):
            c1,c2=cols[j],cols[j+1]
            v1,v2=g[r1][c1],g[r2][c1]
            if v1==v2 and colored(v1) and g[r1][c2]==v1 and g[r2][c2]==v1:
                out[i][j]=v1
    return out

    print(transform(G[k])==G['Demo pair 1 output'])
